claims.claim: Kawhi Leonard scored 21 points in 17 minutes in his Raptors re-debut, a 148-98 preseason win over the Knicks on Oct. 13, 2026
Leonard did not play in Toronto's first two preseason games
Raptors are 2-1 in preseason
A Raptors injury report cleared Leonard from a day-to-day listing on Monday, Oct. 12
Leonard was listed day-to-day since Oct. 3 as not injury related
Rajakovic said Leonard's minutes would be limited and the goal was for him to have fun and get integrated

The Clippers traded Leonard back to Toronto in a deal delayed by an NBA salary-cap circumvention investigation; Ingram, Dick, two unprotected first-round picks, a 2027 pick swap and two second-rounders went to Los Angeles
The team, owner Steve Ballmer and several executives were severely punished; Leonard received a relatively small fine

claims.claim: Toronto's next preseason game is at the Knicks on Oct. 15, followed by the Pistons on Oct. 16; regular season opens Oct. 21 vs. Chicago
No specific reason was given for Leonard's day-to-day listing beyond not injury related
